h: Inviting Atika to the Meal of the Tree of Life

p: At the morning meal of Shabbos
of the holy Ari, of blessed memory:
אֶלָּא חָמָא דָּוִד דְּבָעֵי הַזְמָנָה וְכוּלֵּי
Rather, David saw that an invitation is required, etc.,
that we should bless toward the Upper World,
from which all sustenance and blessings
and therefore it is in a hidden manner,
for the Upper World is hidden,
and toward it there is no invitation, etc."
all the more so Atika Kadisha,
which is the most hidden of all hidden
"And I invite to it now Atika Kadisha"?
it is known that at every meal
there is concern of the accusation of the yetzer hara,
as it says in Sifrei, Eikev,
that the yetzer hara has dominion only
שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה מַכְנִיס קְדוּשָּׁה בַּאֲכִילָה
through which one brings holiness into the eating,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרָכוֹת (נג סוֹף עַמּוּד ב)
as it says in Berachos (end of 53b);
"May He send your help from the Sanctuary,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק ג קעג, א)
that is, help against the yetzer hara
And this is what the holy Zohar says here:
to bless the Holy One, blessed be He,
the Other Side is subdued, etc."
And in the holy Zohar further on (188b):
That is, the invitation is effective
from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of good.
And then one also attains Daas,
which is the inner aspect of Keser Elyon;
but it is through a lens
and that is the Name Adnus,
the aspect of the Lower World.
which is in a hidden manner":
that is, Binah, the Upper World,
and it is in a hidden manner,
That is, when the attainment of Daas
that is, the joining of wisdom in the mind
then "knowledge will be pleasant to your soul";
about this the holy Zohar says,
"and toward it there is no invitation."
אַף שֶׁזּוֹכִין גַּם כֵּן לְהַשָּׂגַת הַדַּעַת
Although one also merits the attainment of Daas,
it is only as the Avos merited
the Name Havayah that was said to them,
but they did not grasp it
except through a lens that does not shine,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ קפז רֵישׁ עַמּוּד ב)
(as it says in the holy Zohar, beginning of 187b);
"But My Name Hashem I did not make known to them."
But this is only when one merits Daas
from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of good,
where "the side of good takes hold
of the entire Other Side and subdues it."
אֲבָל מִי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה מִסִּטְרָא דְּעֵץ הַחַיִּים
But one who merits from the side of the Tree of Life,
and they merit Keser Elyon itself,
that is, the entire Name Havayah
with the crown of the yud,
then they invite even Atika Kadisha,
the most hidden of all hidden,

p: And on Shabbos there is a revelation of Atika,
especially at this meal of Atika;
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (דָּנִיֵּאל ב, כב)
along the lines of what is said (Daniel 2:22),
"He knows what is in the darkness,
and the light dwells with Him."
That is, in the first utterance
and then one merits the side of the Tree of Life,
as it says, "Those who taste it merit life."
And we say, "And may He show us His hidden things":
הַיְינוּ יָשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סִתְרוֹ (תְּהִלִּים יח, יב)
that is, "He made darkness His hiding place" (Tehillim 18:12),
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (דְּבָרִים לב, ב)
along the lines of what is said (Devarim 32:2),
which is the dew of Atika,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג פח, ב)
that is, it shines into the heart,
as it says, "and you shall say in your heart":
אֲמִירָה בַּחֲשַׁאי (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רלד, ב)
And therefore we say at this meal,
"And I invite to it now Atika Kadisha."
And the main revelation of Atika
will be in the World to Come,
meaning that there will shine like day
which is the aspect of Atika.
that the yetzer hara be cleared from his heart,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם כֵּיוָן שֶׁיֵּשׁ מְצִיאוּת מֵרָע
when the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts
with the utterance "You shall not have"
מִכָּל מָקוֹם חָזַר יֵצֶר הָרַע לִמְקוֹמוֹ
nevertheless the yetzer hara returned to its place.
אֲבָל שַׁבָּת שֶׁהוּא מֵעֵין עוֹלָם הַבָּא
But Shabbos, which is a semblance of the World to Come,
that is, one sixtieth of the World to Come
שֶׁעַל זֶה מוֹרֶה לְשׁוֹן אֶחָד מִשִּׁשִּׁים
for this is what the expression "one sixtieth" indicates,
a semblance of the World to Come;
"And I invite to it now Atika Kadisha."

The Gemara says: There are five matters in our world which are one-sixtieth of their most extreme manifestations. They are: Fire, honey, Shabbat, sleep, and a dream. …”

p: And regarding the mann, it is brought
in the holy Zohar, this parashah (208a):
the mann that came down to Yisrael in the wilderness
that mann was from the dew above,
which came down from Atika, the hidden,
and from it Chakal Tapuchin was nourished,
וְהוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב גַּם כֵּן בַּגְּמָרָא (יוֹמָא עה, ב)
And it is as is said also in the Gemara (Yoma 75b):
וְכִי מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת אוֹכְלִין לֶחֶם וְכוּלֵּי
Do then the ministering angels eat bread? etc."
both these and those are the words of the living God;
for the mann in its essence,
and the ministering angels eat it,
But as it came down below
as is brought in the holy Zohar there:
אֶלָּא כְּמָה דְּאַתְּ אָמַר (בְּמִדְבַּר יא, ז)
'And the mann was like coriander seed,'
the ministering angels did not eat,
And about the mann above it says
that it shone from all the worlds.
that the eating of Shabbos is like the eating of mann;
וְיֵשׁ רֶמֶז לָזֶה מִגְּמָרָא (סוּכָּה לט, ב)
and there is an allusion to this from the Gemara (Sukkah 39b):
"they taught it as worth only so much as the mann."
That is, the eating of Shabbos
is like the eating of the mann
that it was different in its fragrance and taste.
And this was like the food of the companions
"Wisdom gives life to those who possess it"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סא וְסב)
and it is from the side of the Tree of Life:
